'''Security Checkpoint 14''' was an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] outpost located in the [[Shadow Town]] sector on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It provided power to [[Duras Fain's hideout]].
